opportunities.name: United.com flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: Search United flights from {origin} to {destination}, {trip type}, on {depart date}/{return date}, for {travelers} in {cabin}, optionally with miles, then review or pick a fare.
steps: Open united.com Book > Flight tab
Pick Roundtrip or One-way; tick 'Book with miles' if needed
Type origin in From and pick the airport from suggestions
Type destination in To and pick the airport/all-airports option
Open the date picker, move to the right month, pick depart (and return) date
Open Travelers and set adults/children counts
Pick cabin class (Economy / Premium economy / Business)
Click Find flights
On results, review fares; open Details/Seats or pick a fare column for the outbound (and return) flight

Santa Fe SAF→Phoenix PHX, roundtrip Aug 13–Aug 28, 1 adult; picked Economy outbound and return

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor restaurant search by city with filter
opportunities.description: On Tripadvisor Restaurants, search {location}, apply a {filter} (cuisine, dietary need or feature), and look at matching restaurants.
steps: Open Tripadvisor home and click Restaurants
Click the 'Where to?' box and type the location
Pick the matching location suggestion
In the left filter panel, click 'Show more' under the right filter group if needed
Tick the wanted filter option (e.g. cuisine) and click Apply
Look through the results; optionally open a restaurant (Order online / Save to a Trip)

instances.values: San Francisco, CA; Dietary Restrictions = Kosher
Central Park, New York; Cuisine = Italian
Los Angeles; Cuisine = Indian; opened Urban Masala and saved it to a new trip 'Los Angeles'
Big Sur, CA; Restaurant features = Outdoor Seating

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search parking for an {event} at {venue}, optionally set the entry/exit times and accessibility filters, and look at or book a spot.
steps: Open spothero.com and type the venue in the search box
Pick the venue address from the suggestions
In the venue events popup, optionally pick a date, then pick the event
Optionally click Filter, tick a filter (e.g. Wheelchair Accessible) and click Show Results
Optionally change Enter After / Exit Before times and click Update Search
Look through the garages; click Book Now on the one you want

instances.values: Barclays Center; Orlando Magic at Brooklyn Nets Apr 7; times changed to 3:00 PM–5:00 PM; Book Now at 201 S Portland Ave
Busch Stadium; Pirates at St. Louis Cardinals Apr 13; filter = Wheelchair Accessible
Barclays Center; date Apr 9, Philadelphia 76ers at Brooklyn Nets; filter = Wheelchair Accessible; entry changed to 10:00 AM, exit 5:00 PM

opportunities.name: United 'Explore destinations' map search
opportunities.description: Use United's interactive map search to find flight deals from {origin airport}, with trip type, dates and max price.
steps: Open united.com Book menu > Map search (Explore destinations)
Type the origin in 'Flying from' and pick the airport
Set the trip type (Roundtrip) and Dates (Flexible dates) if needed
Click Search
Open 'List of search results' to see the destinations and prices

instances.values: Las Vegas LAS, Roundtrip, Flexible dates (cheapest in next 30 days), $2000
